headline: On October 17, 1979: Mother Teresa awarded Nobel Peace Prize
captionCards: Mother Teresa wore a simple sari, symbolizing her vow of poverty.
Her Missionaries of Charity now operates in over 130 countries.
instagramCaption:
Mother Teresa honored with the Nobel Peace Prize. \\[Blank Line] On October 17, 1979, Anjezë Gonxhe Bojaxhiu, known as Mother Teresa, was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for her work with the poor in Calcutta. She founded the Missionaries of Charity, which continues to serve the destitute and dying. Surprisingly, she wore a simple white sari with blue borders, symbolizing her commitment to the poor. Her legacy of compassion and service still inspires millions today. \\[Blank Line] What impact do you think Mother Teresa's work has had on global charity? \\[Blank Line] Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
